item.title: Nick Fyffe Grooves in Newly Released 2001 Jamiroquai “Love Foolosophy” on Later with Jools Holland
item.description: Jamiroquai revisits their 2001 era with a fresh release from Later with Jools Holland showing Nick Fyffe locked into the smooth and heavy Love Foolosophy pocket.

item.title: G. Gould GGi5-Studio^3: A Graphite-Neck Powerhouse with Triple EMG E-Series Pickups
item.description: Geoff Gould’s GGi5-Studio³ blends graphite-neck innovation with a myrtle burl top and triple EMG E-Series pickups. See photos, full specs, and details.

item.title: Death By Audio Unveils Destroyer Series: Three Compact, Stereo Pedals Built for Maximum Mayhem
item.description: Death By Audio launches the Destroyer Series, featuring the Dream Station reverb/delay, Moonbeam Phaser, and Thee Treble Overload treble boost.

item.title: Flea Unveils “A Plea,” the First Look at His Upcoming Debut Solo Album
item.description: Flea has announced his debut solo album and released “A Plea,” a 7-minute jazz-funk exploration with upright bass, horns, and a video directed by Clara Balzary.

item.title: David Byrne’s Stripped-Down Band Highlights Inventive Bass Work at Tiny Desk
item.description: David Byrne brings a lively, joyful Tiny Desk set, and Kely Pinheiro’s steady Bass lines keep the groove locked in as the band leans fully into the fun.

item.title: Robin Mullarkey Finally Drops His Debut Solo Album "Black Swan" and Reveals the Gear Powering His Jacob Collier Tours
item.description: Robin Mullarkey releases his debut solo album Black Swan and breaks down the basses, pedals, and touring setup he uses with Jacob Collier.

item.title: Port City Amplification Unleashes the Tempest: A Hand-Wired Tube Bass Head Built for Modern Players
item.description: Port City Amplification enters the bass world with the Tempest, a hand-wired 60-watt tube bass head blending vintage tone, modern versatility, and premium components.

item.title: Mark Peric Pushes the Groove Forward with the Fusion-Charged “Easy Tiger”
item.description: Easy Tiger finds Mark Peric leading a powerhouse live band with fat low end, sharp horn lines, and an aggressive jazz funk fusion groove that feels alive and locked in.

item.title: How to Add Soulful R&B; Feel to Your Bass Lines with Slides and Grace Notes
item.description: Learn how to add soulful R&B feel to your bass lines using slides, grace notes, and major pentatonic moves. A simple way to bring life and expression to your groove.

item.title: Fender Marks Iron Maiden’s 50 Years With Limited Steve Harris Precision Bass
item.description: Fender honors Iron Maiden’s 50th anniversary with a limited Steve Harris Precision Bass, featuring a satin black finish, vintage specs, and 80s-voiced tone.
